title: seafoam christmas quilt set
text: seafoam christmas quilt set. Ok... I knew this was a bit different for a "Christmas" quilt - by the color alone, but I thought I'd try...  The material is very nylon and snags.  It slips off the bed at every opportunity.  The color - predominately seafoam green is just not Christmas enough for me.  I will say that I have thick, memory foam pillows for the slipcover cases and they were a dream to put on as they were stretchy and large.  Also, I had thought it would be a bit wider as a coverlet/bedspread - but - it was not.  I wish the material was not nylon, snaggy and slippery - but it is.  In all honesty I donated it.
